attacks.claim: The offline expiry check only catches a device clock set earlier than the download time. A clock set between download time and `valid_until` leaves an expired forecast showing in color, which violates the agreed rule that the app never presents stale safety information as current.
attacks.evidence: "The expiry rule above applies on-device using device time... The app also stores the server time at download; if the device clock reads earlier than that, the stored forecast is treated as expired." QA only tests "Device clock moved earlier than offline download time" and "device clock set past valid_until", not a clock between those two bounds.
